reason: Pixel-identical rendering fails even for the unmodified baseline, confirmed by independent native short raw-RGB probes before encoding. Use task-relevant invariants; retain pixel error as an explicit diagnostic.
changed_acceptance: Numerical trajectories, phase sequence, initial/final state and numeric HDF5 fields must agree within1e-10
Entire privileged trace must equal, including camera intrinsics/extrinsics, object poses, contact and success metrics
Three video streams must preserve frame count, size, frame rate and codec; native format validation must pass
Pixel-exact gate remains reported separately; full decoded max and mean absolute errors are reported, with no claim of pixel equality
At least10% component-time reduction; failure outcome retained and heldout initial condition must pass
interpretation: Allows only a motion/format-preserving collection efficiency conclusion. RGB appearance equivalence remains measured, not proved pixel-exact. No task success detector, collision rule, camera, codec, speed or physics change.

prior_work.finding: Maintainer explains output need not be perfectly deterministic across hardware/drivers; temporal anti-aliasing is a possible cause, not established here
Includes render-repeatability examples and discussion; reports disagree by environment/backend. Not evidence for a particular cause on this machine
